newsitem.title: USA: Democrat Kerry wins Massachusetts Senate-TV networks.
newsitem.headline: Democrat Kerry wins Massachusetts Senate-TV networks.

text.p: Massachusetts Sen. John Kerry won a third term, beating the state's Republican governor William Weld in one of the election's closest races, television networks projected on Tuesday.

Both Kerry and Weld were popular with voters in the traditionally Democratic state. Victory in Massachusetts was essential to Democrats if they were to hold hope of regaining control of the Senate, where Republicans have a 53-47 seat advantage.
